info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Logistics Shipments Etas-v2-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipment ETA API provides users with real-time estimated times of arrival for shipments in transit. It allows businesses to efficiently track their logistics operations and manage customer expectations by retrieving accurate shipment ETA data. This API is ideal for logistics managers and customer service representatives who need to provide updates on shipment statuses. Users can interact with the endpoint to gain insights into delivery timelines and optimize supply chain processes.

get.summary: Retrieve Estimated Time of Arrival for Shipments
get.description: This endpoint allows users to obtain the estimated time of arrival (ETA) for specific shipments. By providing the relevant shipment details, users can effectively track delivery times and enhance logistical planning.

requestBody.description: Request to retrieve the estimated time of arrival (ETA) for shipments. This endpoint requires a JSON payload that specifies the necessary parameters for the request.
